verdict.rationale: The docs reference a dedicated CI API key, SDKs in five languages for automating workflows, idempotent retry-safe runs, and pass thresholds on scorers. Baseline-vs-candidate comparison runs against frozen suite versions are also documented, so evals can plausibly be triggered from CI. However, nothing documents a CI integration or a deployment-gating mechanism that fails a pipeline on results. Missing for 10: a documented CI integration (e.g. GitHub Action or CLI), an explicit pass/fail exit status or gating workflow for blocking deploys, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
